syllabus_topics: Analysis of heat transfer problems: methodology
Absorption, reflection, and transmission by real surfaces
Radiation exchange between opaque, diffuse, and gray surfaces in an enclosure
assessment_rules: To pass the course, the overall mark must be at least 5/10, and the mark in each of the five exams must be at least 3/10. For the extraordinary assessment, students must retake all exams with a mark below 5/10; voluntarily retaking a passed exam requires prior notification. The final mark will be the maximum of two calculations: one using the regular distribution, and another assuming each exam accounts for 20% of the total.
bibliography: F.P. Incropera, D.P. De Witt, T.L. Bergman, and A.S. Lavine, Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer, 6th Edition, John Wiley & Sons, Hoboken (NJ), 2007. [Chapter 1 for Unit 0.]
